coupling_analysis.blur_x_gamma: Gamma compresses gradients by g*V^(g-1)<1 in midtones -> gm_ratio 0.19-0.39 looks like heavy blur although the true blur is mild sigma=1.0. Subtype DT flips between GAUSSIAN/GLASS/MOTION across pairs because after gamma the residual MTF/anisotropy is content-driven; only the exact-match test pinned gaussian:1.
coupling_analysis.gamma_x_noise: HSV-V gamma in uint8 creates contouring in dark areas -> wavelet MAD sigma 0.37-3.83 (fake noise) and §B extreme_pct up to 71%. sigma scale spread across an identical pipeline is impossible for real noise. Smooth-region local_std below no-noise sim confirms no additive layer. Real blur before gamma smooths the contouring (targets smoother than gamma-only sim).
coupling_analysis.gamma_x_saturation: chromatic chroma ratio 0.35-0.66 suggested SATURATION_weaken sev5, but (max-min) chroma scales with V under gamma; HSV S ratio 1.01-1.02 (scale-invariant) proves saturation is untouched.
coupling_analysis.gamma_x_contrast: variance_ratio 0.20-1.00 and contrast_spread_ratio ~0.71 could suggest contrast_weaken, but contrast preserves the mean; observed mean_shift -44..-76 and power-law V curve with S preserved identify gamma darkening instead.
coupling_analysis.gamma_x_compression: pair4 unique_G=181 (<200) and dct_zero_ratio=0.87 trigger compression FP checks, but block_boundary<=1.02 on all pairs and the bit-exact reproduction without any JPEG step rules out compression.

final_decision.rationale: Exact pixel-level reproduction (PSNR=inf, CI=10/10) of every one of the 5 paired supports by blur_gaussian:1 -> brightness_darken_gamma_HSV:5. Both steps are deterministic and independently corroborated: V-space power-law gamma 3.2-3.6 with saturation preserved, clipping fractions matching sev5; mild-blur spectral signature with order proven by the reversed-order control. No noise (sigma prior variability is a gamma artifact; smooth regions smoother than the no-noise sim), no compression (block_boundary<=1.02, exact match without JPEG).
final_decision.alternatives_note: No alternative retained: main candidate is bit-exact 5/5. Next-best gamma-only (30.43 dB) is superseded and only serves as an audit milestone.
final_decision.qwen_noise_gate: unavailable in this environment (no Qwen API/tool exposure); noise presence was decided quantitatively instead (smooth-region local_std vs no-noise gamma sim)
